title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon
alternative_titles: 龍が如く７　光と闇の行方
description: A role-playing game following Ichiban Kasuga as he rebuilds his life after prison and betrayal. He gathers a party of outsiders in Yokohama, battles through turn-based encounters, and explores a city filled with side stories and minigames.

player_sentiment.summary: In the sampled r/patientgamers discussion, players praise the emotional story, humor, and side activities while debating slow pacing and leveling requirements. Some describe boss difficulty spikes as frustrating grind; others find the available arena and side content sufficient. This is a limited sample, not a representative player consensus.
positives: Emotional storytelling and an engaging protagonist
Absurd humor and imaginative turn-based encounters
negatives: Boss difficulty spikes that some players experience as forced grinding
Job leveling can discourage experimentation for some players
